basis: The dashboard legend (lower right) is a vertical, monotonic scale labeled “High”/“100” at the top in pale yellow and “Low”/“0” at the bottom in dark burgundy, with intermediate ticks 80, 60, 40, and 20. Comparing the three offered states on this same scale: Utah (UT) is filled with the lightest/very pale yellow, placing it near the high end (approximately the 80–100 band); Delaware (DE) is a more saturated yellow/orange, clearly darker than UT and therefore lower on the scale; and Vermont (VT) is dark burgundy, matching the low end (near 0–20). Thus, among the offered records, UT has the highest encoded risk index. The routing criterion is the “Highest risk state in the dashboard,” which selects the highest-risk offered record for the priority follow-up workflow.
option_label: Open Utah (UT) risk detail for priority follow-up
